华为云统一身份的长期票根，作用域 auth.huaweicloud.com ——: The long-lived ticket of Huawei Cloud unified identity, scoped to auth.huaweicloud.com — in a CodeArts account this is the only thing you need to look after: both the per-package credits and the expiry dates ride on it. The plugin replays SSO with it to mint a web session cookie on the spot (a short-lived artifact the portal issues; gone the moment the browser closes) and writes the result back to the account, so you never paste it yourself. That is also why this panel has no session-cookie input: the cookie is the sprout this ticket waters, not a second thing to hand over. After switching computers or reinstalling, this item is enough; no digging cookies out of the browser. Signing in through the EMBEDDED WINDOW fills this item in automatically; you only need to add it by hand after signing in through the SYSTEM BROWSER, or when the upstream did not issue a ticket during that sign-in. How to get it (any of the three, all on auth.huaweicloud.com — do not look under codearts.huaweicloud.com, it is not there): 1) sign in to codearts.huaweicloud.com, press F12 → Application → Cookies → expand https://auth.huaweicloud.com → copy the Value on the SSOTGC row (pasting the whole row with Path / Domain is also fine, the gateway extracts the value); 2) in Network open any request to auth.huaweicloud.com → Request Headers → copy the SSOTGC=… segment from Cookie; 3) in a Reqable capture filter by auth.huaweicloud.com and look at the same Cookie request header. The value looks like TGTX--…-sso (about 100 characters); anything else is rejected with a hint. The stored value is never displayed.
